newsitem.title: UK: Refuge has 90.6 pct United Friendly shares.
newsitem.headline: Refuge has 90.6 pct United Friendly shares.

text.p: Refuge Group Plc said on Tuesday it had received acceptances representing approximately 90.6 percent of United Friendly Group's ordinary shares and 65.47 percent of its B share capital.
"The ordinary offer for United Friendly ordinary shares has become unconditional as to acceptances with effect from September 13, 1996," the British life assurer said in a statement.
Refuge's proposed merger with United Friendly, which was announced in August, has caused disquiet among some major shareholders, who were wavering on whether or not to back it.
This led Refuge to propose the issue of a security which will give its shareholders access to any future assets from its ordinary branch.
